The average support would exceed h_B, contradicting compatibility. Thus after possibly reversing the integer base, A can be chosen as a smallest endpoint, including all ties. The triangular affine map therefore has one invertible continuous block shared by all fibers, which multiplies every mixed mass by the same absolute determinant. It maps convex hulls, actual support and closed halfspaces bijectively, so depth fractions and compatibility transfer.
